title: Bà Trùm Kim Cương
location: Bậc thềm đá trước sảnh cẩm thạch của tòa nhà kính sang trọng giữa Hà Nội; clip cuối trong chiếc xe tải trắng đỗ bên kia đường.
axis: Xe sang đỗ sát bậc thềm, đầu xe quay sang trái khung hình; bà Hoa bên trái, ông Lâm bên phải; cửa xoay và hai bảo vệ ở hậu cảnh. Trong xe tải: Mai bên trái, ông Khoa bên phải, hai laptop trước mặt.
props: Xe sang màu đen không logo, mũ tài xế màu đen của ông Lâm (thay mũ cối), kính đen to và mũ rộng vành đen của bà Hoa, trâm cài hoa vàng giấu camera tí hon, tai nghe nhỏ của Mai, hai laptop sáng trong xe tải.
setting: Morning outside the marble lobby of a gleaming Hà Nội glass tower: a revolving door, potted palms, polished stone steps reflecting the light.

clips.extras: two security guards in grey uniforms standing by the revolving door

wardrobe.@Lam: a crisp black chauffeur cap, faded grey zip-up windbreaker over a white tank top, loose khaki trousers, plastic sandals, a dark-green dragon tattoo on his right forearm hidden by his sleeve

steps: @Lam stands at the open driver's door of the black sedan in a crisp black chauffeur cap and is already speaking toward the two guards by the revolving door, stern and mock-formal.
@Lam keeps talking as he squares his shoulders and tugs his grey windbreaker straight.
@Lam flicks two fingers upward at the guards as he goes on, thick grey eyebrows drawn together.
@Lam taps the top button of his own windbreaker while he keeps speaking.
@Lam keeps speaking with a stiff formal frown, his narrow eyes sliding from one guard to the other.
@Lam glances pointedly down at the guards' shoes while he talks.
@Lam keeps talking, his eyes travelling slowly back up to their faces.
@Lam keeps talking, lowering his voice and raising one thick grey eyebrow.
Over a guard's grey shoulder, @Lam keeps talking sternly and twirls one finger in a turning-around motion.
@Lam keeps speaking as the two guards straighten up by the revolving door, chins raised.
@Lam spreads both hands wide as he names the big sum, lips moving fast.
@Lam keeps talking and taps his own chest with a curt nod.
@Lam finishes the warning and closes his mouth, lips pressed into a straight line.
@Lam marches stiffly around the gleaming hood of the black sedan, mouth closed.
@Lam opens the rear door with a deep, precise bow and holds it wide, mouth closed.
clips.sfx: a smooth engine purring to a stop, a car door clicking open, two pairs of heels clicking together, distant city traffic
clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Này, hai cậu. Đứng thẳng lưng lên tí nào, cài cúc áo vào. Bà chủ tôi khó tính lắm, nhìn giày trước rồi mới nhìn mặt. Ai lôi thôi là bà ấy quay xe, công ty các cậu mất toi mười tỷ, rồi đừng trách tôi.

wardrobe.@BaHoa: a wide-brimmed black hat, big black sunglasses, purple floral silk blouse with a large gold flower brooch with a tiny hidden camera on the chest, black wide trousers, chunky gold bangle, low heeled sandals

steps: @BaHoa steps out of the black sedan's open rear door in big black sunglasses and a wide-brimmed black hat, dips her chin toward the large gold flower brooch on her chest and is already speaking softly into it.
@BaHoa keeps whispering into the brooch as she rises tall, one hand smoothing her purple silk blouse.
@BaHoa rolls her eyes with a tiny shrug while she speaks, as if remembering something.
@BaHoa taps the brooch lightly with one fingertip as she talks.
@BaHoa touches her own ear and shakes her head as she keeps speaking.
@BaHoa flaps one hand dismissively at the brooch, still talking low.
@BaHoa keeps talking as she straightens her shoulders and settles her chunky gold bangle.
@BaHoa lifts her chin like an actress stepping on stage, still murmuring.
@BaHoa purses her red lips between phrases and keeps talking.
@BaHoa keeps murmuring as the tiny lens at the center of the gold brooch glints once in the sun.
@BaHoa wags one finger at the brooch as she goes on, a warning half smile on her lips.
@BaHoa finishes the aside and closes her red lips.
@BaHoa slowly lowers her sunglasses with one finger, mouth closed.
@BaHoa gazes up at the glass tower with a regal half smile, mouth closed.
@BaHoa sets one sandal on the first polished stone step, mouth closed, chin high.
clips.sfx: heeled sandals tapping on stone, a gold bangle clinking, a soft breeze in the palms, a car door thudding shut
clips.speaker: @BaHoa
clips.line: Mai ơi, hình về rõ chưa cháu? À quên mất, cái trâm này có mắt mà không có tai, bà hỏi cũng bằng thừa. Thôi kệ, vào vai rồi thì cứ thế mà diễn, hỏng một câu là không được quay lại lần hai đâu đấy.
clips.tone: hushed and sly, a private aside

turns.speaker: @BaHoa

turns.speaker: @Lam

turns.speaker: @BaHoa
turns.line: Suỵt! Tài xế thì phải cúi đầu, cấm cười, cấm nháy mắt với tôi.

clips.setting: Inside a parked white van turned into a surveillance post by day: two laptops glowing, tangled cables, a thermos, tinted windows facing a busy street.
steps: @Mai, a small headset pressed to one ear, leans toward the two glowing laptops and is already speaking fast with bright eyes.
@Mai keeps talking excitedly, pointing at one glowing blank screen.
@Mai shakes her wrist beside her ear to mimic a jingling bangle as she goes on, grinning.
@Mai keeps speaking fast, pressing the headset closer to her ear.
@Mai keeps talking, tapping her own chest where a brooch would sit.
@Mai covers both ears with her hands in a playful imitation and keeps talking, giggling.
@Mai finishes and closes her mouth, bouncing in her seat.
@Khoa lowers his magnifier glasses over his eyes and answers in a dry nasal voice without looking away from the screens.
@Khoa keeps talking flatly, one corner of his mouth twitching upward.
@Khoa glances up at the van roof as he goes on, eyebrows raised.
@Khoa keeps speaking and scratches one cheek as if remembering old mosquito bites.
@Khoa keeps talking, turning to @Mai and lifting one long finger, while @Mai listens, mouth closed.
@Khoa points the long finger at a key as he finishes, and @Mai nods, mouth closed.
@Mai's fingertip presses the key at once, the blue glow of the screen on her knuckle.
The fingertip lifts away from the keyboard in the soft blue glow, the laptop fan humming.
clips.sfx: laptop fans humming, muffled street traffic, a faint crackle in a headset

turns.speaker: @Mai
turns.line: Hình về rồi ông ơi! Nét lắm, đến tiếng vòng vàng của bà kêu leng keng cũng nghe rõ mồn một. Bà còn tưởng cái trâm không có tai cơ!

turns.speaker: @Khoa
turns.line: Hồi trẻ muốn nghe trộm, ông phải bò trên mái nhà cả đêm, muỗi đốt sưng cả mặt. Thôi, bấm ghi đi cháu.

title: Hưng Cắn Câu
location: Phòng sếp vách kính của công ty Phú Quý trên tầng cao tòa nhà kính, nhìn ra phòng gọi điện đòi nợ.
axis: Bà Hoa ngồi sofa da trắng bên trái khung hình, Hưng bên phải cạnh vòng đèn livestream; ngoài vách kính phía sau là các dãy bàn gọi điện.
props: Điện thoại gắn gimbal của Hưng, sofa da trắng, khay trà với hai cốc thủy tinh, trâm cài hoa vàng giấu camera, mũ rộng vành và kính đen của bà Hoa.
setting: The flashy call-center office of a loan app company high in a Hà Nội glass tower by day: rows of desks with young callers in headsets at glowing monitors, purple and gold neon accent lights without letters, a glass-walled boss room with a white leather sofa and a ring light.

steps: @Hung holds a phone on a small selfie gimbal at arm's length in the glass-walled boss room, its blank screen glowing, and is already talking fast into it with a cocky grin.
@Hung keeps talking as he walks past the ring light, tugging the collar of his black satin bomber jacket straight.
@Hung winks at the phone and gives the gimbal a quick little wave while he talks.

@Hung leans close to the lens, eyebrows dancing, and keeps talking fast.
@Hung rubs his silver-ringed thumb and fingers together as he goes on, grinning.
@Hung keeps speaking and flashes both hands open twice at the lens.
@Hung keeps speaking and mimes knocking on a door with two knuckles.
@Hung keeps talking as he checks his ash-blond undercut in the dark glass.
@Hung smooths one side of his undercut with his silver-ringed fingers while he talks.
@Hung makes a heart shape with his fingers at the phone as he keeps talking.
@Hung finishes with a wink, closes his mouth and taps the glowing phone to end the stream.
@Hung strides out through the glass door with both arms spread wide in welcome, mouth closed.
@Hung crosses the call-center floor between the rows of glowing desks, a closed-lip grin stretching ear to ear.
@Hung stops by the entrance and straightens his bomber jacket, mouth closed, ready to greet his guest.

clips.speaker: @Hung
clips.line: Cả nhà ơi, anh tắt sóng mười phút nhé! Có một bà trùm bất động sản đang lên tận đây xin rót vốn cho anh, nghe đâu mấy chục tỷ. Thần tài gõ cửa thì phải chạy ra đón chứ, đúng không nào. Thả tim đi các em, lát nữa anh kể hết!

@BaHoa keeps drawling grandly, crossing her legs and smoothing her purple silk blouse.

turns.speaker: @BaHoa

title: Khoa Báo Vào Phòng Máy
location: Hành lang công ty và phòng máy chủ lạnh ngắt trong tòa nhà kính; clip cuối trong chiếc xe tải trắng bên kia đường.
axis: Hành lang: ông Khoa đi thẳng về phía ống kính, vách kính mờ hai bên. Phòng máy: cửa kính có khóa số bên trái, dãy giá máy chủ bên phải. Xe tải: Mai ngồi trước hai laptop, cửa kính màu phía sau lưng.
props: Mũ thợ màu xanh, tai nghe tí hon và hộp đồ nghề của ông Khoa, kẹp tóc bẻ cong, ổ cứng nhỏ màu đen, tai nghe có micro của Mai, hai laptop sáng.
setting: A cold server room in the glass tower: tall black server racks with blinking blue lights, cable trays, a humming air conditioner, a glass door with a keypad lock.

clips.setting: A bright corporate hallway high in the glass tower by day: grey carpet, frosted glass walls, ceiling lights, a potted plant by a corner.

wardrobe.@Khoa: a blue technician cap over his grey ponytail, a tiny earpiece in one ear, brown multi-pocket vest bristling with little tools over a blue checkered shirt, grey trousers, canvas shoes

steps: @Khoa ambles toward the camera down the bright hallway in a blue technician cap, swinging a toolbox, touches the tiny earpiece in his ear and is already speaking in a dry nasal voice.
@Khoa keeps talking with a loose, bored gait like any ordinary repairman on his rounds.
@Khoa tugs the brim of his blue technician cap as he goes on, face deadpan.
@Khoa keeps speaking and nods at an empty frosted doorway.
@Khoa keeps talking flatly and waves one long hand in front of his own face.
@Khoa keeps speaking, eyes half closed, the toolbox swinging at his side.
@Khoa keeps talking, glancing sideways at nobody in particular.
@Khoa presses the earpiece a little deeper while he talks.
@Khoa keeps speaking and lets one corner of his mouth droop, eyebrows lifting.
@Khoa pats his chest lightly with two fingers as he keeps talking.
@Khoa lifts his chin with a wistful little sniff as he goes on, smoothing his grey ponytail.
@Khoa finishes, closes his mouth and stops beside a glass door.
@Khoa's long fingers draw a bent hairpin from his vest pocket.

clips.sfx: soft footsteps on carpet, the hum of ceiling lights, a toolbox handle creaking, a distant elevator chime
clips.speaker: @Khoa
clips.line: Ông vào trong được rồi đấy, cháu ạ. Đội cái mũ thợ điều hoà lên là thành người vô hình, cả tầng chẳng ai thèm liếc ông lấy một cái. Nói thật là cũng hơi chạnh lòng, hồi ấy đi đâu cũng có người ngoái nhìn.

clips.speaker: @Khoa
